title: PROG (Digitone program changes)
author: irpina
description: PROG, the smallest program change mod for the Digitone mk1: every program change the unit receives shows for two seconds in the screen's corner (its channel and program, and + when the stock applies it too), and the ones on MIDI channel 16 are its own, so the stock never changes the pattern for them. A template for a mod that answers program changes (docs/ADAPTING.md, "Program changes"): it names no firmware address, so its OS 1.44 port is empty. Needs core-dn1 4.0.
